ITALIC = CSI + '3m'
UNDERLINE = CSI + '4m'
BLINK = CSI + '5m'
REVERSE = CSI + '7m'
HIDDEN = CSI + '8m'

# Colors
COLORS = {
    'green': 32,
    'red': 31,
    'blue': 34,
    'white': 37,
    'yellow': 33,
    'cyan': 36,
    'magenta': 35,
    'black': 30,
}

KATAKANA += 'アァカサタナハマヤャラワガザダバパイ'

# Lambda character
LAMBDA = 'λ'

# Default settings
DEFAULT_DELAY = 4
DEFAULT_COLOR = 'green'
DEFAULT_TTY = None

class CMatrix:
    def __init__(self):
        self.async_scroll = False
        self.bold = False
        self.all_bold = False
        self.no_bold = False
        self.force_term = False
        self.linux_mode = False

        self.x_mode = False
        self.screensaver = False
        self.update_delay = DEFAULT_DELAY
        self.color = DEFAULT_COLOR
        self.message = None
        self.tty = DEFAULT_TTY
        self.use_katakana = False
        
        # Terminal dimensions
        self.rows = 0
        self.cols = 0
        
        # Matrix data
        self.columns = []
        self.current_color = COLORS[DEFAULT_COLOR]
        
        # Old terminal settings
        self.old_settings = None
        
    def parse_args(self, args):
        """Parse command line arguments"""
        i = 0
        while i < len(args):
            arg = args[i]
            if arg in ['-h', '-?']:
                self.print_help()
                sys.exit(0)
            elif arg in ['--help', '--version', '-V']:
                if arg == '-V':
                    self.print_version()
                else:
                    self.print_help()
                sys.exit(0)
            elif arg == '-a':
                self.async_scroll = True
            elif arg == '-b':
                self.bold = True
            elif arg == '-B':
                self.all_bold = True
                self.bold = True
            elif arg == '-c':
                self.use_katakana = True
            elif arg == '-f':
                self.force_term = True
            elif arg == '-l':
                self.linux_mode = True
            elif arg == '-L':
                self.locked = True
            elif arg == '-o':
                self.old_scroll = True
            elif arg == '-n':
                self.no_bold = True
            elif arg == '-s':
                self.screensaver = True
            elif arg == '-x':
                self.x_mode = True
            elif arg == '-r':
                self.rainbow = True
            elif arg == '-m':
                self.lambda_mode = True
            elif arg == '-k':
                self.chars_change = True

                    i += 1

                    i += 1
            i += 1
